identified_issues: Breaker BKR_512 was actuated without an approved, pre-authorized Switching Order in DISPATCH_EMS prior to physical operation, violating Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.1.
Field maintenance crew attempted a retrospective ticket submission (SO-2026-8812 / EMS_LOG_9941), which is explicitly invalid under Section 4.2.3 and cannot cure an unauthorized line disconnection.
evidence: DISPATCH_EMS registry log at 2026-10-06T15:45:00.000Z and 15:50:00.000Z confirms 'Pre-authorization status: NONE' and no switching order on file for BKR_512.
RELAY_SEL_451 event log records front panel manual trip depressed at 2026-10-06T16:10:02.100Z and breaker contact state changing to OPEN at 16:10:02.145Z.

DISPATCH_EMS completion log at 2026-10-06T16:12:15.000Z records retrospective entry EMS_LOG_9941 referencing unapproved order SO-2026-8812 submitted post-switching with status RETROSPECTIVE_UNAUTHORIZED.
recommended_action: Enforce strict pre-switching interlocks preventing manual or remote maintenance tripping without an active, validated Switching Order token in DISPATCH_EMS. Conduct a formal compliance incident review for the unauthorized feeder disconnection and implement mandatory procedural retraining for Substation North 14 field personnel.
